item_short_desc: Rothco's MultiCam T-Shirt is crafted with a blend of comfort and durability, made from a robust 5.5 oz cotton jersey material. The camo shirt is designed with licensed MultiCam fabric through CRYE Industries, ensuring an authentic and high-quality camouflage pattern. This uniform t-shirt features a double-needle stitch for enhanced durability and longevity, making it perfect for various outdoor activities and casual wear. The 100% cotton construction provides a soft and breathable feel, ensuring all-day comfort.
